items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I knew him years ago, yeah.

ctx.x: Who plays the thing like a trombone. Had you known him before?
Yeah, I knew him years ago, yeah.
He played string bass with Ba sie, oh, much later, I think, in the late forties, or something like that, when Walter Paige had left. So I was really surprised the way he played tuba.
